bootstrap_fixture.negative_increment_rule: Reject incompatible inputs; do not clip silently

source_formula_caveats: Eq33.19 printed lower sum index n is undefined in the local T0..TN notation; mapping to 0 is a mathematical inference, not an official erratum.
Printed gamma denominator product ends at N whereas the author's solution uses N-1; direct swap product/Jacobian derivation should justify implemented domain.
Table33.4 raw component norms at rows 1 and 9 do not round exactly to the listed total, but component-rounding norm intervals intersect the total interval. No evidence of an irreconcilable typo.
section_33_2.closure_boundary: Model, caller-specified contracts, bootstrap and independent numerical checks can be completed. Original flexicap three prices and unconditional sticky table reproduction must remain explicitly unverified. Introduction-only CEV/Bermudan discussion may be explanation evidence if the accepted scope explicitly classifies it that way; do not claim a numerical CEV/Bermudan engine from explanations.
section_33_2.baseline_existing_status: No private LMM production module found in the investigated checkout; independent /tmp scratch and design exist.

parameters.original_time_unit: Quarter; original table prints all rate/volatility labels as /quarter except r=/year. SDE dimensions require distinction between drift per-quarter and diffusion per-sqrt-quarter; retain quarter time for the original dt=1 fixture.
parameters.currency_unit: USD million; revenue and fixed expenses per quarter; cash and loss carry-forward stocks in USD million

equations_and_accounting.growth_discrete_noise_caveat: Author scanned PDF confirms the extra sqrt(dt) outside the OU variance square-root. For original dt=1 quarter it has no effect. For substeps, exact frozen-eta OU variance is eta^2*(1-exp(-2*kappa*dt))/(2*kappa), with no further dt factor; do not claim the printed arbitrary-dt formula is exact.
equations_and_accounting.operating_ebitda: R-Cost=(1-alpha-beta)*R-F, before cash interest and tax
equations_and_accounting.retained_cash_interest: Operating cash is retained and earns the risk-free rate; the paper says to add cash interest to revenues in Eq6.
equations_and_accounting.pretax_budget: Operating EBITDA plus interest on retained cash (source does not spell out exact discrete simple/continuous interest timing).
equations_and_accounting.tax: Eq6 uses (1-tax_rate); paper sets the effective tax rate to zero while loss carry-forward is positive.
equations_and_accounting.loss_carry: dL=-Y*dt if L>0; if L=0, dL=max(-Y*dt,0). In continuous time this preserves L>=0; discrete crossing/partial taxation convention is not explicitly specified.
equations_and_accounting.cash: dX=Y*dt; a survivor's terminal distribution includes retained cash. Do not both distribute all intermediate operating cash and count it again in terminal retained cash.
equations_and_accounting.bankruptcy: Paper defines bankruptcy at first hit X=0; Hull BS36.1 states cash<0. With discrete simulation, use an explicit convention and stop after default; forced cash exhaustion differs from optimal abandonment.
equations_and_accounting.terminal: Paper Eq10 values retained cash at horizon; later adds terminal value equal to 10 times pretax operating profit (EBITDA). Source does not explicitly state quarterly-to-annual EBITDA conversion or whether negative survivor terminal EBITDA is floored.
equations_and_accounting.net_company_PV: E_Q[exp(-r_annual*25)*(retained_cash_T+terminal_business_value_T)*survival_indicator] is the bookkeeping construction implied by cash retention plus terminal business value; exact terminal annualization is a stated implementation convention, not an explicit source fixture.

original_paper_comparison_values.statement: Values recovered from source, not recomputed in this investigation. Original MC seed/SE and discrete accounting order are not given.

capital_structure_recovered.exercise_rule: All ESO/convertibles are assumed exercised/converted at their maturities on survival paths, even when not economically optimal. This is the base-case approximation, not LSM optimal exercise.
capital_structure_recovered.equity_cash: Subtract principal and after-tax coupon payments to debt holders and add option exercise receipts; include issued shares.
capital_structure_recovered.debt_refinancing_assumption: Equivalent debt is issued when debt is paid so that enterprise cash/bankruptcy dynamics remain unchanged; capital structure does not alter the simulated total-securityholder cashflows.

split_adjusted_1998_inference.statement: 1998 table after the Sept1999 2-for-1 split matches the paper's rounded 76M/60M under7.50 statement. This suggests the source-date sentence in the paper may be inconsistent; this is not author-confirmed, and the original ESO input or maturity-offset rule has not been recovered.

section_36_4.closure_boundary: The stochastic business/accounting model, explicit units and reproducible conventions can be implemented and independently checked, and source enterprise/bankruptcy values can be reported as comparison targets. Original stock $12.42 is not verified until the missing/inconsistent ESO input and equity cash allocation are resolved. Do not back-fit parameters, silently replace the paper's data by true 1999 values, or call unverified original prices N/A.
section_36_4.baseline_existing_status: No private Schwartz–Moon/business-state implementation found; this is implementation work as well as source-input work.

33.2.limitation: 単一curve・正の単利forwardのLMM。rolling/terminal/payment-bond drift、reset freeze、割引、caplet/ratchet/sticky/最初の5回のITM flexicap、frozen-forward swaption/PCAをcallerが固定した契約で検証する。sticky K0とflexicap strike/対象fixing/payment不足により原典3.43/3.58/3.61等の価格は未再現。CEV/Bermudanは紹介のみで、市場fitや多curve拡張は対象外。

36.4.limitation: 原論文から回収した四半期パラメータを用い、売上log Euler・成長率OU・税損失繰越・現金・倒産・終価と希薄化を検証する。会計の売上時点/終価利益期間と資本構成はcaller入力。dt=1の原著OUと細分時の正しい分散を区別。原典5457M/27.9%/株価12.42はaccounting・従業員optionの基準日/満期等が確定せず未再現。合成契約/補助入力を原典価格の再現としない。
